 Headmaster under probe for alleged sexual harassment
 Headmaster under probe for alleged sexual harassment
 25-Oct-2026, 16:06 25 Oct 2026, 16:06 FMT Reporters Share The individual has been temporarily moved to the Bagan Datuk district education office pending completion of the probe, says the education minister.
 Screenshots from a video, which has gone viral, showing the Form 3 student’s parent confronting the headmaster at the school. (Threads pic) 
 PETALING JAYA : The headmaster of a vernacular school in Teluk Intan, Perak, is being investigated by education authorities for allegedly sexually harassing a Form 3 student. 
 In a post on Threads, education minister Fadhlina Sidek said she has ordered the Perak education department to investigate the allegations.
 “The headmaster involved has also been temporarily moved to the Bagan Datuk district education office pending the completion of the investigation,” she said.
 The headmaster is alleged to have harassed the student through text messages, resulting in one of the girl’s parents confronting him at the school.
